# Market Union Co. Ltd. - Rudeco

> > A verified Diamond Member kitchenware and home goods manufacturer and trading company based in Ningbo, China, offering OEM/ODM services across multiple product categories.

Market Union Co. Ltd. is a Ningbo-based supplier on the Made-in-China marketplace specializing in kitchenware, home goods, cleaning products, and dining utensils. The company serves as both a manufacturer and trading partner with verified credentials and customization capabilities.
